item.title: github: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
item.description:
GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says both are intended for agentic coding and code review, with stronger coding judgment than earlier GPT-6 models.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GPT-6.1 Terra in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for everyday agentic coding and terminal work, and costs less than GPT-6.1 Sol.

  • Source: GitHub
